notes.subject: gɔsila-dɔnni
notes.rationale: תושיה ye 'dɔnni min bɛ a yɛrɛ to ka bɔ tiɲɛ na' kɔrɔ — gɔsila-dɔnni ye a dɔgɔya dɔɔnin

notes.subject: שגג/משגה
notes.rationale: shogeg/mashgeh — daɲɛ fila minnu bɔra jɔyɔrɔ kelen na (ten/tenbaga), ka nyɛ wuli Bamanankan na

notes.subject: לו
notes.rationale: Ni Ye ka kuma: 'olu bɛ a la' walima 'a bɛ olu mara' — kumasen kɔfɛ 'deceiver and deceived are his' ka kɛ masalayɛlɛma ye

translation: A bɛɛ la, se ni gɔsila-dɔnni bɛ yen; min bɛ ten, ni min bɛ mɔgɔw ten, olu bɛɛ bɛ a la.
